name: Morse.IsVariation
why: Same data (U open containing 0, alpha u t in N on U x [0,1], end points alpha u 0 = alpha 0 0 and alpha u 1 = alpha 0 1). Smoothness: the project asks C^infty on every closed strip U x [s,t] in U x [0,1] with no break point inside, the blind file on the strips between consecutive points of {0,1} u (B n (0,1)); equivalent (strips_iff: a break-free [s,t] lies between the last point <= s and the first point >= t, which are consecutive). Equal for all arguments.
